title: UNIQON Restaurant POS • Windows Desktop Release v1.0.0
highlights: High-speed Restaurant POS billing for Dine-In, Takeaway, and Counter orders.
Integrated 80mm & 58mm TVS Thermal Printer support with Direct Silent Printing.
Dynamic UPI QR code generation on bill slips for instant Google Pay / PhonePe payments.
Smart Global Search across all menu categories with Item Code (#101) & Dish Name instant lookup.
Tamil & English bilingual dish receipts with offline auto-translation.
Offline SQLite database with automatic daily closing backup protection.
